purpose: Provisions a subscription, schedules the renewal notice and the dunning sequence, and writes the access-until date on cancellation.

reads.note: entitlements are granted only for an `active` subscription
stored as the renewal date the notice job and the dunning scheduler both fire on
the entitlement row keys off the price the customer is on
an unpaid invoice enters the dunning sequence
stored so support can trace an invoice to the payment that settled it
the invoiced amount shown on the customer's billing history
the renewal notice is sent only when the next invoice is for more than zero
quoted in the renewal notice as the period the charge covers
entitlements are revoked once the subscription reads `canceled`
the access-until date written on cancellation; the customer keeps access to it
